ARCX:BTC.name: Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust ETF

scaling_source.rationale: The listed trust provides spot Bitcoin exposure; BTCUSDT supplies a liquid continuous intraday path for ladder scaling.

ARCX:BTC.selection_rule: one-standard-error plateau, then minimum distance from prior published parameters
ARCX:BTC.completion_assumption: unfilled weekly shares valued at next reference; no automatic broker execution
notes: BTCUSDT is the registered intraday scaling proxy; order prices are applied to the user-entered BTC reference price.
The 09:35 bar sets the reference and is excluded from fills; eligible lows begin at 09:36 ET.
Unfilled weekly quantity is completed at the next available reference in the walk-forward cost calculation.
Proxy price touches approximate rung hits; they do not model the listed instrument's spread, queue position, partial fills, fees or market impact.
Deadline tightening and the optional sell closeout are execution overlays, not independently optimized backtest policies.
